title: Genetic Modification of DREB Gene in Various Organisms
summary: This cluster involves the modification of the unique DREB gene in various organisms. BaDBL1 was modified to produce the unique DREB gene, while Oliver was modified to produce Yao, which in turn was modified to produce Liang, who was modified to produce Gao. Gao was also modified to produce Yao. The modified CTAB protocol and plant DNA extraction method were not directly related to the modification of the DREB gene in this cluster. The organisms involved in this cluster are primarily focused on genetic modification and expression of the DREB gene.
